wrist_deflection_from_rgbd — DRIVE pegtactile op

• Data kinds: rgb × image2d × matrix × matrix × signal × signal × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.wrist_deflection_from_rgbd(rgb, depth, K, R_cam_to_world, cam_w, carriage_pos, r_peg: 'float', hinge_z: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegtactile; pegtactile.wrist_deflection_from_rgbd(rgb, depth, K, R_cam_to_world, cam_w, carriage_pos, r_peg: 'float', hinge_z: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("wrist_deflection_from_rgbd"))

Usage

Translational deflection and tilt of the wrist from 1 wrist RGB-D frame: peg pixels (pegsim color classification) → depth point cloud → PCA axis → cylinder fit with known radius (pegsim.cylinder_fit_known_radius) → axis line in the world frame → in the carriage frame (subtracting the encoder-known position carriage_pos), the point at hinge height z = hinge_z = (Δx, Δy). Tilt (θ_x, θ_y) from the axis direction via atan2. The cylinder's axial position is not visible, so Δz is not reported (honestly: the wrist's z compression is covered by k̂ and the tactile F_z, pegtactile_process_episode). Returns dx, dy, axis, tilt_x, tilt_y, rms_cyl, n_pts. Raises ValueError: shapes do not match, fewer than 50 peg pixels (not visible).
